# classroom

7 curated tools, plus 105 generated tools (Google Discovery parameter names; see `classroom_discover`).

## `classroom_create_coursework`

Class: create

Create a Classroom assignment (or short-answer question) as a DRAFT unless you pass state PUBLISHED. Attach Drive files by id and links, set points and a due date. A draft is invisible to students until classroom_publish.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account) |
| `courseId` | string | required | Course id |
| `title` | string | required | Assignment title |
| `description` | string | optional | Instructions |
| `workType` | enum | optional | ASSIGNMENT (default) or SHORT_ANSWER_QUESTION |
| `maxPoints` | number | optional | Maximum points (omit for ungraded) |
| `dueDate` | string | optional | Due date YYYY-MM-DD |
| `dueTime` | string | optional | Due time HH:MM in UTC (Classroom stores UTC; needs dueDate) |
| `topicId` | string | optional | Topic id to file it under |
| `state` | enum | optional | DRAFT (default) or PUBLISHED |
| `driveFileIds` | array | optional | Drive file ids to attach (the files must already be in Drive) |
| `links` | array | optional | Links to attach |
| `shareMode` | enum | optional | How students get the Drive files: VIEW (default), EDIT, or STUDENT_COPY (each student gets a copy) |

## `classroom_create_material`

Class: create

Create a Classroom material (a post of resources, no grade) as a DRAFT unless you pass state PUBLISHED. Attach Drive files by id and links. A draft is invisible to students until classroom_publish.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account) |
| `courseId` | string | required | Course id |
| `title` | string | required | Material title |
| `description` | string | optional | Material text |
| `topicId` | string | optional | Topic id to file it under |
| `state` | enum | optional | DRAFT (default) or PUBLISHED |
| `driveFileIds` | array | optional | Drive file ids to attach (the files must already be in Drive) |
| `links` | array | optional | Links to attach |
| `shareMode` | enum | optional | How students get the Drive files: VIEW (default), EDIT, or STUDENT_COPY (each student gets a copy) |

## `classroom_list_courses`

Class: read

List Google Classroom courses the account teaches or attends (id, name, section, state, link). Active courses by default.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account); "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `courseStates` | array | optional | Course states to include (default ACTIVE) |
| `pageSize` | integer | optional | Items per page (default 30) |
| `pageToken` | string | optional | nextPageToken from the previous answer |

## `classroom_list_coursework`

Class: read

|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account); "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `courseId` | string | required | Course id (from classroom_list_courses) |
| `states` | array | optional | States to include (default PUBLISHED) |
| `pageSize` | integer | optional | Items per page (default 30) |

## `classroom_list_submissions`

Class: read

List student submissions for one assignment (id, student userId, state, late, grade). Pass "-" as courseWorkId for every assignment of the course.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account); "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `courseId` | string | required | Course id |
| `courseWorkId` | string | required | Assignment id from classroom_list_coursework, or "-" for all |
| `states` | array | optional | Submission states to include |
| `userId` | string | optional | Only this student (user id, or "me") |
| `pageSize` | integer | optional | Items per page (default 30) |
| `pageToken` | string | optional | nextPageToken from the previous answer |

## `classroom_publish`

Class: update

Publish a DRAFT Classroom assignment or material so students see it (and are notified). Get the id from classroom_create_coursework, classroom_create_material or a list tool with states DRAFT.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias (omit for the default account) |
| `courseId` | string | required | Course id |
| `kind` | enum | required | coursework for an assignment or question, material for a material |
| `id` | string | required | Item id |
